challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: The current retriggering of the weekly model refresh is still done by hand, which creates a blind spot for the team. I am prepared to accept a less frequent retraining cycle if the trigger itself becomes fully automated. This trade off lets us guarantee that every deployment is traceable and reproducible without the risk of a missed manual step. The reduction in update frequency is a cost I am willing to pay to secure the integrity of the registry and ensure that the model running in production is exactly the one that passed evaluation. This alignment is critical for maintaining the operational capability of the platform and for keeping the project costs predictable over the coming quarters.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to accept a less frequent retraining cycle to secure automation and traceability, which fits the definition of a trade-off where something is given up for a desired gain.
